method: Each run transferred a SHA-256-checked archive of its signed work-lane commit to the native guest.
The selected test packed and installed Publisher locally with npm offline and scripts disabled.
Guest test exit and full log were read back separately; host and guest log SHA-256 values agreed.
All runs selected the same Publisher package source tree; test and evidence commits differed.

observations: Relocated executable Provider builds through the installed public CLI; timeout reclaims its descendant without killing an unrelated sentinel.
Frozen historical v1 Provider, Candidate, and Qualification values replay offline.
Offline-installed Publisher and executable Provider produce the selected native and derived input lock.
Adjacent decoys do not change selection; relocated installation and inputs replay identically.
Offline-installed public CLI executes an installed executable Provider and builds one complete Candidate.
Candidate binds the exact input lock and contains nonempty static SVG, static PNG, and standalone interactive HTML.

limits: These are provisional local native probes, not a frozen successor release or hosted Publisher CI.
The historical v1, successor selected-input, and full Candidate runs used different signed test commits even though Publisher package source bytes matched.
Complete dependency observation, every Windows process-tree counterexample, final package/release identity, browser and human review, adopter acceptance, and publication remain unproved.
Raw logs remain in ignored local test work; these attributed observations must be repeated on the final frozen candidate.
